incidents.summary: Racist and offensive messages were exchanged in a Mitie staff WhatsApp group from March 2020, prompting the chief executive to apologise and launch an investigation in February 2022.

sources.title: Mitie
sources.quote: In February 2022, The Sunday Mirror revealed a Mitie WhatsApp group relating to immigration management paid by the Home Office that exchanged racist and offensive messages amongst colleagues since March 2020.

sources.title: CEO of Home Office contractor apologises for racist messages by staff | Mitie | The Guardian
sources.quote: The chief executive of top Home Office contractor Mitie has apologised to the home secretary personally after a series of racist WhatsApp messages shared between Mitie staff emerged.

sources.title: CEO of Home Office contractor apologises for racist messages by staff | Mitie | The Guardian
sources.quote: Boss of Mitie, awarded contracts worth £2.55bn, apologised to home secretary and has launched an investigation

incidents.summary: Dozens of Mitie Care & Custody detention and deportation officers were taking legal action over alleged race, sex and disability discrimination and unfair dismissal.

sources.title: Staff at Home Office contractors sue over discrimination and unfair dismissal
sources.quote: Dozens of security staff who detain and deport people for the Home Office are taking legal action over race, sex, disability discrimination and unfair dismissal, the Guardian has learned.

sources.title: Staff at Home Office contractors sue over discrimination and unfair dismissal
sources.quote: The detention and deportation officers work for Mitie Care & Custody, part of the company Mitie
